title: My utility functions
text: utility functions R, collected instead duplicated across packages scripts. Originally just startup conveniences Rgui Windows (loaded .Rprofile), now also holds heavier, interactively-called helpers – aren’t meant run startup, just live one place instead copy-pasted per package.

title: My utility functions
text: setwd() – replacement base setwd() also updates Rgui window title cd() – shorthand setwd(); remembers previous directory, cd() argument acts like cd - Unix short.path() – shortened display form path (last N components) dropbox_folder() – locate local Dropbox folder Windows

title: My utility functions
text: update_github() – update locally installed GitHub packages save_installed_pkgs() – save names installed (non-base) packages file, upgrading R restore_installed_pkgs() – reinstall packages file saved save_installed_pkgs(), upgrading R update_pkgs() – update installed CRAN + Bioconductor packages one non-interactive run, logging lock-retry handling; meant run background (e.g. Rscript -e "myutil::update_pkgs()") rather RStudio’s (blocking) package updater upgrade_r_library() – run newly installed R bring packages old one: copies patch upgrade (e.g. 4.6.1 4.6.2), reinstalls came (CRAN, GitHub, r-universe, …) minor upgrade; test-loads installed_pkg_sources() – installed package came outdated_pkgs() – packages newer version available (unlike old.packages(), can flag hundreds whose version hasn’t changed), marking whose newer version CRAN source far

title: My utility functions
text: set composable steps CRAN release process, meant run root package released (myutil). Run individually, via release_run_all(). release_preflight() – cross-check DESCRIPTION Version/Date NEWS.md CRAN release_document() – rebuild documentation (devtools::document()) release_spelling() / release_spelling_add() – spell-check, selectively add accepted words inst/WORDLIST release_urls() – check documentation URLs release_site() – rebuild README pkgdown site release_build() – build tarball, vignettes, manual release_check() – run R CMD check ---cran locally release_check_win() – check win-builder (R-devel) release_revdep() – check reverse dependencies release_cran_comments() – regenerate cran-comments.md results steps release_run_all() – run automatable steps sequence, collecting failures instead stopping first one

title: My utility functions
text: man() – open package’s PDF manual (CRAN, built locally) use_data_doc() – generate roxygen documentation shell dataset sourceDir() – source R files directory, e.g. try -progress package changes without reinstalling Rpackages.bib() – write BibTeX file citations installed packages, R project’s dependencies (via renv::dependencies()), attached packages

title: Automate CRAN release checks for a package — release_checks
text: release_*() functions automate repetitive parts preparing R package CRAN release: cross-checking DESCRIPTION/NEWS.md, rebuilding documentation running spelling/URL checks, rebuilding README pkgdown site, building tarball/vignettes/manual, running R CMD check, remote checks (win-builder), reverse dependency checks, assembling cran-comments.md. Run individually iterating release, run whole non-interactive sequence release_run_all().

title: Automate CRAN release checks for a package — release_checks
text: must run working directory set target package's root (package released), myutil's. Intended order: release_preflight() – sanity-check Version/Date/NEWS.md CRAN release_document(), release_spelling() / release_spelling_add(), release_urls() – documentation, spelling, URL checks release_site() – rebuild README pkgdown site release_build(), release_check() – build tarball/vignettes/manual, R CMD check ---cran release_check_win() – win-builder (R-devel); slow, run release_run_all() unless full = TRUE release_revdep() – reverse dependency checks; also opt-via full = TRUE release_cran_comments() – assemble cran-comments.md saved release_check() release_revdep() output still manual: bumping DESCRIPTION's Version/Date, writing NEWS.md entry, actual submission (devtools::submit_cran() reviewing cran-comments.md/diff , routine releases; usethis::use_release_issue() first release open questions worth documenting GitHub issue). See comments top release_checks.R submission automated, notes related tooling (fledge, rhub, goodpractice, foghorn, etc).

title: myutil 1.10.0
text: New upgrade_r_library(), run newly installed R bring packages installed older one. patch upgrade (x.y) copies package folders, packages GitHub, r-universe, R-Forge local files come along without reinstalling; minor upgrade reinstalls package came . Packages new R already left alone; translations packages built R < 4.0 skipped; packages installed local files listed. check = TRUE (default), packages brought test-loaded fresh R processes, batches; dry_run = TRUE shows plan. New installed_pkg_sources(): classifies installed packages came (CRAN, another repository r-universe, R-Forge, Bioconductor, GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket, local), Repository Remote* fields DESCRIPTION. New outdated_pkgs(): packages whose version CRAN newer installed one. old.packages() can flag hundreds packages whose version hasn’t changed (e.g., right R upgrade), update.packages() reinstalls nothing. Also shows newest binary version marks packages whose newer version far available source. save_installed_pkgs() also saves pkginfo, output installed_pkg_sources(), restore_installed_pkgs() uses reinstall package came , skipping packages already installed. Files saved earlier versions still work (CRAN ). update_github() uses remotes::install_github(); imported devtools::install_github(), although devtools suggested, made R CMD check fail. ls.objects() failed objects (clean session); example pattern = "*lm" valid regular expression. setwd()/cd() kept previous directory .lastdir user’s workspace; now kept inside package. dropbox_folder() longer calls require(jsonlite) (imported). Declared utils functions used Rpackages.bib(), update_pkgs() use_data_doc(); .Rbuildignore covers pkgdown files; Description sentence.

text: First version NEWS Added reset_par() (2026-09-01: defined without @export/docs since first added, never actually usable myutil::reset_par(); now exported documented) Added use_data_doc() Added save_installed_pkgs() restore_installed_pkgs(), saving/reinstalling set installed packages across R version upgrade Added CRAN release-check workflow, portable across packages: release_preflight(), release_document(), release_spelling(), release_spelling_add(), release_urls(), release_site(), release_build(), release_check(), release_check_win(), release_revdep(), release_cran_comments(), release_run_all() Enabled markdown roxygen (Roxygen: list(markdown = TRUE)) Reorganized README.md categories Added update_pkgs(), non-interactive CRAN + Bioconductor package updates logging self-locked-DLL retry handling Added Rpackages.bib(), maintaining master BibTeX file R package citations.
